intro: Step into a clutter-free home! The Ewa shoe cabinet is designed to keep your footwear neatly stored while adding a touch of elegance to your entryway. Smart, stylish, and oh-so-functional!

features.title: Versatile storage for all kind of shoes
features.text: Three closed shelves and one open shelf ensure every pair has its place. With space for up to 12 pairs, you’ll never have to search for your shoes again.

features.title: Magnetic catch for secure closure
features.text: Say goodbye to swinging doors and messy piles. The shutter comes with a magnetic catch, keeping everything neatly tucked away while ensuring quick and hassle-free access.

features.title: Air vents for fresh, odor-free storage
features.text: No more worrying about shoe odor! Thoughtfully placed air vents promote circulation, preventing foul smells and keeping your footwear fresh.

features.title: Built to last, designed for stability
features.text: Crafted with engineered wood, the Ewa shoe cabinet stands strong, offering a sturdy and wobble-free design that ensures longevity

features.title: Elegant two-tone design for modern homes
features.text: With a sleek two-tone finish, this cabinet blends effortlessly into any décor, creating a welcoming, organised, and stylish entryway.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Ewa 12 Pairs Engineered Wood Shoe Cabinet
